inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL configuration write converts binary IPv6 data to presentation text with INET6_NTOA after decoding hexadecimal input.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a network-address inventory report over newly authored binary address rows. INET6_NTOA renders a documentation IPv6 address, the all-zero address, and NULL propagation without copying the source schema, variables, or application data.

fixture_notes: Address 801 stores 2001:db8::1, address 802 stores the all-zero IPv6 address, and address 803 has NULL bytes. The converted text is selected directly so binary-to-text behavior and metadata are observable.
determinism_notes: Address IDs and byte strings are fixed, and output is ordered by the unique address ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE network_address_inventory (address_id INT PRIMARY KEY, address_bytes VARBINARY(16) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT address_id, INET6_NTOA(address_bytes) AS address_text FROM network_address_inventory ORDER BY address_id

checks.sql: SELECT address_id, HEX(address_bytes) AS address_hex FROM network_address_inventory ORDER BY address_id
